inventory.description: Tenant-bound target storage inventory with stable Kubernetes identities and source freshness.

backend.description: Tenant-owned storage system and sanitized connection health.

driver-lifecycle-step-input.description: Immutable provider step input for storage driver lifecycle operations.

offering.description: Kubernetes persistent-volume service capabilities; object/bucket and App Market artifact storage are excluded.

binding.description: Offering mapping only to a target-local Kubernetes StorageClass identity.

providerBackendSchema.description: Versioned allowlisted provider attributes rendered by a trusted local component.

storageDriverPackage.description: Provider or extension package declarations for storage identity, compatibility, capabilities, supply chain, and version-bound conformance.

retainedVolumeWorkflowStepInput.description: Fenced Provider input for retained-volume dependency checking and release or sanitization.

retainedVolumeWorkflowResult.description: Provider sanitization evidence or an explicit data-retained manual-release state; never a generic claimRef mutation.
